title: AFTERLIGHT: The World That Was
artDirection: Tactile sculptural still life; midnight blue, ivory, and terracotta. AI-generated artwork.

items.name: The Last Login
items.caption: The doorway outlasted the password.
items.was: A password once stood between people and the lives they had recorded. When the platform went dark, the doorway remained, but the key no longer worked.
items.became: The screen is gone. A path runs through the empty frame and continues beyond it. The record can be read without asking the old gatekeeper to open the door.

items.name: The Cloud Came Down
items.material: Painted steel · ivory housings · frosted acrylic
items.caption: What lived behind one door found many homes.
items.was: They called it a cloud, though it lived behind someone else's doors. Photographs, promises, and entire histories waited inside machines their makers would never see.
items.became: The cabinet opens. Its records are carried outward, each finding a place beyond the original enclosure. The old sign rests on the ground. No single door decides who can reach what remains.

items.name: The Letter That Stayed
items.caption: The messenger disappeared. The message stayed.
items.was: The platform kept the inbox, the address, and the proof that someone had spoken. When it vanished, an unopened letter outlasted the system built to deliver it.
items.became: The envelope opens beyond the frame. A message chosen for the public record can travel without its original messenger. Its meaning belongs to those who encounter it, even when its token belongs to someone else.

items.name: The Square Beyond the Feed
items.caption: A community is larger than its interface.
items.was: A town once lived inside a feed, its streets rearranged by a ranking no one could see. When the screen went dark, the gathering place disappeared.
items.became: The people build a square with many entrances. Paths continue beyond the screen. Its shared record can be read through any window someone chooses to make. The community is larger than the interface that reveals it.

items.name: The Garden of Copies
items.caption: A memory survives by taking root elsewhere.
items.was: The last seed was kept in a vault, safe until the day the keeper disappeared. A single protected copy had become a single fragile point of memory.
items.became: The vault opens into a nursery. Each cutting carries the pattern onward, and new roots take hold beyond its walls. The token can belong to one wallet; the readable record can be held by many.

items.name: The Library Without Doors
items.material: Painted steel · bound paper · ivory ceramic
items.caption: The old door became a place to read.
items.was: The shelves were full, but access belonged to the institution. Its keys, subscriptions, and opening hours decided which stories could be read. When the keeper left, knowledge waited behind a locked door.
items.became: The door is laid down and becomes a reading platform. Books leave the shelves. The record can be found, read, and carried forward by people the original keeper never knew.
